title: Deployment environments
outcome: Explain deployment environments using the deciding step in this fictional service.
scenario: Separate rehearsal and live service. Staging rehearses a new answer version with fictional records; production serves approved school records.
given: Staging card names trial room Z; production card names room A. Credentials and stores are separate.

steps.label: Use staging data
steps.detail: The rehearsal reads fictional room Z.

steps.label: Check actual connection
steps.detail: Staging credentials must not reach production storage.

steps.label: Review evidence
steps.detail: A passing rehearsal supports release review, not automatic promotion.

explanation: An environment includes code, configuration, permissions and data. A staging label alone cannot create separation.

counterfactual.change: Point staging at the production credential.
counterfactual.prediction: Stop the rehearsal because its separation boundary is breached.
counterfactual.reason: Actual access matters more than the environment label.

student_task: Identify the staging data and credential boundary. Why must the rehearsal stop if its credential reaches production even though the process is labelled staging?
teacher_answer: The rehearsal reads fictional room Z. Staging credentials must not reach production storage. A passing rehearsal supports release review, not automatic promotion. Changed case: Stop the rehearsal because its separation boundary is breached. Actual access matters more than the environment label.
project_evidence: For the Grounded Learning Service, retain an annotated trace and the changed-case result. Name the contract or evidence that makes the deciding step valid, so another team can review it.
limits: Fictional fixtures can miss live edge cases; use approved privacy-safe representative test conditions too.
review_note: Individually authored fictional practice, distinct from the reserved independent case. These stipulated records illustrate reasoning; no real service execution or learner outcome is claimed.
